ink-soft.purpose: Secondary deep navy within stage wash.

paper.purpose: Primary text on dark stage; selection inverse.

peach.purpose: Contact section ground (same hex as paper).

muted.purpose: Secondary labels and descriptions on stage.

orange.purpose: Warmer companion accent in stage glows.

display.purpose: Section titles, brand-scale type, ghost headlines.

shadows.name: header-soft
shadows.purpose: Fixed site header lift over the stage.

components.name: Skip Link
components.description: Focusable skip control; paper on ink.
components.css: .skip-link { position: fixed; z-index: 200; top: 0.75rem; left: 0.75rem; padding: 0.75rem 1rem; background: #ffedd5; color: #050a12; font-family: "DM Sans", sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Project Card
components.description: Image-led film tile with soft radius.
components.css: .project-card__link { display: block; height: 100%; border-radius: 1.35rem; overflow: hidden; background: #050a12; }

components.name: Contact Pill
components.description: Ink pill on peach contact field.

narrative.overview: Warm cinematic portfolio on an ink stage lit by amber/orange practicals. Outfit display and DM Sans UI keep chrome quiet so films and photography lead. Contact inverts to peach paper. Motion stays short and respectful of reduced-motion; future engagement motion is site-wide, not photography-biased, and previews on mbu-eng only.

rules.name: Work Leads
rules.body: Experience surfaces let media and brand atmosphere dominate the first viewport; avoid dashboard chrome and carded hero media.

rules.name: Preserve Tungsten
rules.body: Extend existing CSS tokens; do not replace with purple-glow or cream-serif AI defaults.

dos: Do preview engagement motion on mbu-eng only
donts: Don't invent a new brand system
Don't bias motion to photography alone
Don't deploy experimental motion to production mbu without approval
